response.sql: WITH project_ratios AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, 1.0 * SUM(s.boxx) / NULLIF(SUM(s.boxz), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), compared AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS excess FROM project_ratios) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, excess FROM compared WHERE excess > 0 ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A zero or missing Z total makes the ratio undefined; such projects cannot exceed their funding source's average.
